name: contract-artifact-byte-snapshot
goal: Validate, hash and store the same generated audio bytes even when the input uses an own getter

evidence: capture reads input.bytes separately for WAV validation, hashing and persistence. A getter can supply a different valid waveform on later reads, so returned media identity and saved audio can describe different data than validation examined.

The existing one capture/initialized case supplies a plain Buffer and misses repeat reads of accepted getter properties. Strengthen that same case with an own bytes getter returning two distinct valid WAV buffers. Assert one read, original authored hash and identical stored bytes; retain the existing plain-buffer and invalid-property checks. No additional test declarations.
